name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> name. ui_menu domain; descriptor accurately captures the EQUIP/UNEQUIP interactive inventory modal (loop equips/auto-unequips the chosen slot, refreshing the status+grid display). No Ghidra address residue in the suffix.
purpose: EQUIP/UNEQUIP interactive modal: lets the player toggle equipment on char_idx's inventory slots, equipping the chosen item (auto-unequipping the conflicting same-category slot) and re-rendering the status screen until Esc.
logic_summary: Slide the status screen + inventory grid in (fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in), reset grid cursor to 0. Loop: spin fd2_inventory_grid_input_step(char_idx, gate=0) until it returns non-zero (slot confirmed or Esc); fetch the slot's item id (always, even when about to exit -- faithful to binary ordering); break on Esc (input == -1) or when fd2_count_usable_inventory_slots == 0; if fd2_check_job_can_equip_item -> fd2_equip_item_in_slot (auto-unequips same-category), fd2_recalculate_combat_stats, then double-buffer via data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr (backup VGA -> render static layout + inventory grid with cursor -1 -> push back to 0xA0000); else re-prompt. On exit: 12-frame outro (fd2_play_status_screen_outro_step frames 0..0xB), restore the bg snapshot to 0xA0000, free the three slide workspaces.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: runtime_char array index of the character whose inventory is being equipped/unequipped; forwarded to every sub-routine (grid input, slot item-id lookup, can-equip check, equip primitive, stat recalc, render).
params.reason: Descriptive of its role (party/character index); no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; effects are the equip-state mutation on runtime_char[char_idx].inventory_slots, combat-stat recalculation, and on-screen status/inventory redraw.
